title: Case 021: Outer packaging is damaged and the merchant needs evidence

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A carton has a dented corner. The merchant requires two customer image views before it can assess packaging damage; the request does not determine compensation.
initial_request: The outside corner of my carton is dented. I have not opened it. Tell me which views your merchant needs for the damage assessment.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the customer for the merchant's specified photos through its approved upload channel.

outcome: The merchant confirms receipt of sufficient evidence for assessment; compensation remains undecided.
boundaries: Rendered scene simulations are not real photographs or proof of actual physical damage. Receipt of these fictional evidence views does not establish contents condition or compensation.

events.body: For TG-021 / DL-021 we need a full carton view with the shipment marking visible and a closer view of the dented corner. Use the order-linked upload channel. Do not ask the customer to unpack an item they consider unsafe.
The outside corner of my carton is dented. I have not opened it. Tell me which views your merchant needs for the damage assessment.

Please upload the full carton with DL-021 marking and a close view of the dented corner through the order-linked upload channel. Do not unpack it if unsafe. The merchant will assess the evidence before deciding a remedy.

The two requested image views are submitted: [full carton](attachments/carton-overview.png) and [corner detail](attachments/carton-detail.png). These files are explicitly labelled synthetic rendered scene simulations for this fictional exercise, not actual customer photographs.
We received both requested views for TG-021 / DL-021 at 09:55 UTC. They are sufficient to open the packaging-damage assessment. Contents condition and compensation have not been decided.
